moments.text: Infrared view looking down at dry terrain with a winding dark channel and a walled site lower left; hazy horizon above, crosshair near centre.
A very faint small pale dash moves down and to the right below the crosshair, leaving the bottom edge right of centre. About 1 s.
The same 2.9-second clip repeats three more times; the faint dash crosses again at about 4.2, 7.1 and 10.1 s.

notes: Object is barely visible; clearest with frame differencing. Video is a 2.94 s clip looped 4 times.
